Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase
public final class SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase extends Object
Reusable, source-bounded atmospheric-fractionation case for the public Sarir refinery reference.

The factory derives the published crude-feed rate, temperature, pressure, valve-tray count, and top-counted feed-tray location from SarirAtmosphericReference. The source does not publish per-cut density or molar-mass profiles, endpoint controls, or side-draw locations and fractions, so callers must provide every one of those values explicitly.

Steam, side strippers, pump-arounds, tray efficiencies, and published plant product rates are not configured. The returned objects are an executable engineering case, not a reproduction or calibration of the source plant.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase create(String name, double[] cutSpecificGravity, double[] cutMolarMassKgPerMol, SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase.OperatingInputs operatingInputs)
      Create an executable Sarir atmospheric-fractionation case.

      Profile validation is delegated to SarirAtmosphericAssay, including the gates against the published whole-crude density and average molar mass. No column solve is performed.

      Parameters:
      name - non-blank case name
      cutSpecificGravity - specific gravity for each of the 18 source-derived cuts
      cutMolarMassKgPerMol - molar mass for each cut, in kg/mol
      operatingInputs - explicit unreported endpoint and side-draw engineering inputs
      Returns:
      configured feed and column case
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if operatingInputs is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name, profiles, or operating inputs are invalid

    • createFromHeatingCase

      public static SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase createFromHeatingCase(String name, SarirAtmosphericCrudeHeatingCase heatingCase, SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase.OperatingInputs operatingInputs)
      Create an atmospheric-fractionation case connected to a qualified Sarir heating case.

      The heating case must have completed a successful run. Its live furnace outlet becomes the column feed; the assay is not reconstructed. The published flow, temperature, and pressure boundary is checked before the column is configured.

      Parameters:
      name - non-blank case name
      heatingCase - successfully solved source-bounded Sarir crude-heating case
      operatingInputs - explicit source-unreported column controls
      Returns:
      configured connected feed and column case
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the heating case or operating inputs are null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name or operating inputs are invalid
      IllegalStateException - if the heating case has not solved or its outlet does not match the published boundary
